why: The three modules that build DOM from user-supplied text: the shared tool shell (_editor.js), the diff renderer, and the QR panel. Each assigns innerHTML and/or calls document.createElement, and measured 2026-09-05 they are the only three of this repo's 11 linted files that carry any markup construct at all — the other eight score zero on innerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, outerHTML and createElement. features/code-data.js is deliberately absent: it carries the declared §15 opt-out, its report is join('\n')-ed and rendered as text, and the rule resolves to severity 0 for it.
